headline: Battle Lines Shift Across the Front
war_summary: The latest returns show a front still in motion, though several hot sectors have slackened since the previous edition. WeatheredExpanseHex has become the liveliest theater, with ten strategic-base events in two hours and thirty-nine over the day; ownership now stands at five Colonial and four Warden bases. FishermansRowHex has cooled to two recent events but leads the daily ledger with thirty-nine, and its bases now report nine Colonial-held positions. StlicanShelfHex likewise eased to five events in two hours, with thirty-four across the day, while its six Warden, two Colonial, and one neutral bases remain unchanged. MooringCountyHex recorded no fresh movement in two hours, yet retains sixteen daily events and an eleven-to-one Warden advantage. StonecradleHex is quiet at present, its divided line unchanged at five Warden and four Colonial bases after ten daily events. CallahansPassageHex has added three events during the day amid a sharp surge in recent casualties, but no current ownership shift is recorded. Most other regions remain still or show only routine activity.
